## H1 — early warning (P(x)-changing drifts, runs with a visible accuracy drop)

* Paired delay vs DDM p = 0.002, vs ADWIN[err] p = <0.001, vs PH[err] p = 0.007 (one-sided, label-free earlier).
* Verdict: **NOT CONFIRMED**
